notes.title: Version 1.2.2 has arrived with The Codex Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, and a thousand praises to you, Your Majesty!

My Lovely Empress has an update for you with [b]a brand new feature[/b], the Codex! 

Read all about the various denizens of (and visitors to) the Crimson Empire that you have already met, and even review their appearances. 

If part of an Emperor's duty is knowing his subjects inside and out, our new Codex ought to make it easy!

For the [b]complete details[/b], please refer to the patch notes below:
[list]
[*]Added Character Codex : Revisit all unlocked characters any time from the main menu.
[*]Added the ability to immediately close the help window from any pages.
[*]Added option to disable the Help Page from popping up after story dialogues.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=OeqF5T-bs8o;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for your continued support for My Lovely Empress. We hope to see you again soon in Ashuwa, Your Majesty!

~ Neon Doctrine 💜

[b]My Lovely Empress[/b], 50% off:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990/My_Lovely_Empress/

notes.title: Introducing the Codex Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Your Majesty. 

We're pleased to be graced by your presence once again. The Crimson Empire has flourished in your absence-- though certainly not as much as when you personally oversaw our every move. 

In celebration of our [b]My Lovely games being a part of the Women's Day sale[/b], our skillful developers have crafted a [b]codex update[/b] just for you:

[h3]An artifact that displays all of your royal subjects and lovely Yaoguai for your perusal![/h3]

[previewyoutube=OeqF5T-bs8o;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, [b]My Lovely Wife and My Lovely Empress will be on discount for 60% and 50% respectively until March 8, 10AM PT[/b].

We hope to see you again in the Ashuwa continent! Your devoted Yaoguai remain at your command, ready to accomplish any imperial missions you may have for them.

~ Neon Doctrine 💜

notes.title: The Serenity Update is now available on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Greetings, Your Majesty! The Serenity Update is now available on Steam and Nintendo Switch, with long much requested improvement AND a new relaxing “Serenity” mode based on YOUR feedback 👑

Please keep your feedback coming!

Here’s the full patch notes:

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]: [list][*] Fixes & Changes: [/list] [list] [list] [*] Fix Unlock All Gallery Slow Hit Steam Achievement
[*] Fix Kingdom Quest didn't randomize on aura & persepolis kingdom [/list] [/list] [list]

[*] A slight adjustment on the difficulty and balancing of the game: [/list] [list] [list]
[*] Slight increase on gold gain per population
[*] Slight decrease on soul vitality decay
[*] Slight decrease on population loss when in low trust [/list] [/list]
[list] [*] A new difficulty mode called "Serenity" where a bunch of values is adjusted in the game to make player more comfortable playing the game. The difficulty option will only available in the main menu. Details of the changes:  [/list] [list] [list] [*] Big increase on gold gain
[*] Big decrease on soul vitality decay
[*] Big decrease on population loss when in low trust
[*] Disable population imbalance issues
[*] Increase trust gain on issues solved
[*] Increase starting gold, trust, and population
[*] Increase soul essence gained from disaster & sacrifice
[*] Increase relation gain on completing ruler’s favor
[*] Slight increase on item gained in exploration
[*] Reduce marriage cost*
[/list] [/list]

*Please note that the reduced marriage cost doesn’t apply to real life marriages.

notes.title: Updated My Lovely Empress to v1.0.6!
notes.content:
Greetings, and a thousand praises to you, Your Majesty!
My Lovely Empress has been updated to v1.0.6, with both bug fixes and typo fixes
to smoothen out your game-play experience. Please let us know how your
experience with My Lovely Empress has been, and thank you for all of support you
have shown the game. We look forward to your continued reign over the Crimson
Empire!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[h3]My Lovely Empress v1.0.6[/h3]
[i][b]Fixes & Changes:[/b][/i]
• Changed texts warning the player of low population for both the Noble and
Commoner factions.
• Reduce low population warning threshold & reduced the chance of it being
spawned.
• Fixed a missing Simplified Chinese translation for "give cure".
• Fixed Umamu being unable to essence feast due to her XP being capped
out.
• Fixed Farah’s good ending triggering the achievement for her bad ending.
She’s not /that/ hard to talk to!
• Fixed marriage button causing the love confession scenes to loop nonstop.
Nobody actually wants the moment to last forever!
• Auto-adjusted texture quality to mid and turned off anti-aliasing if the user’s
GPU VRAM is below 1024 MB when opening the game for the first time on
PC. This is to fix startup crashes.

[i][b]Fixed typos:[/b][/i]
• Fixed a typo when talking to Jing.
• Removed a line where Hong calls himself the heir to the throne despite already being on the throne.
• Edited Han’s low citizen population dialogue.
• Edited Chen’s low noble population dialogue.
• Fixed Chapter 6 having the line "man Iove" instead of "man I love”.
• Fixed the typos in Hu’s second visit.

In case you missed it my liege, My Lovely Empress is out now! 

We want thank everyone who took part in giving us such an amazing launch day. We're overjoyed that so many of you joined us in sowing death and destruction upon Ashuwa 🔥

We also want to say another [b]huge[/b] thank you for 95% positive reviews! If you haven't yet, here's a reminder to leave a review of your own, it really helps for the visibility of indie games like ours! 🖤

notes.title: Introducing The My Lovely Series Bundle!
notes.content:
Greetings your most esteemed radiance, 

[h3]In case you missed it, My Lovely Empress will be releasing on August 21st at 12:00am PDT!![/h3]

To commemorate My Lovely Empress's formal addition to the My Lovely Family, we are pleased to announce a brand new bundle of dark delights for our most committed! 

The [b]My Lovely Series Bundle[/b] will ALSO be launching on August 21st and will provide players with an additional [b]15% discount[/b] on top of any other discounts running!. 

Featuring My Lovely Daughter, My Lovely Wife, AND a freshly released My Lovely Empress - it will be your opportunity to gather the entire family in one fell swoop. This is a 'complete the set' bundle so if you already own the first two games in the series, the 10% discount will apply to you too. 

BUT that's not all! If art and music are your passion, the My [b]Lovely Empress Deluxe Edition[/b] will include both the Artbook and the Original Soundtrack for your enjoyment. 

We are enthusiastically counting down the days until the 21st of August, and we hope you are too. Thank you all once again for joining us on this journey. 

Every Wishlist counts for games like these, so keep 'em coming! 

~ Neon Doctrine 🖤

Remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=rda&utm_medium=steam][i][u]Wishlist[/u][/i][/url] the game, join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd][u][i]community[/i][/u],[/url] and follow our [url=https://neondoctrine.games/m/links][i][u]socials[/u][/i][/url] so you don't miss the notification when it drops!

notes.title: A Trilogy Of Offerings Are Coming...
notes.content:
Hello to all our wonderful My Lovely Series Players! 

Neon Doctrine and GameChanger have been gathering the materials for a special ritual, and it is almost ready. 

On the [b]23rd of June, at 10am PDT[/b] we will have a trilogy of incredible content to offer you while you wait for My Lovely Empress! Hold on to your wallets too, because we also have a [b]Steam Daily Deal[/b] for My Lovely Wife and My Lovely Daughter on update day. Get prepared for some pretty epic discounts on the 23rd. 💸

[h2]🔪My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn[/h2]
My Lovely Daughter is getting resurrected in 4K. [i]My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn[/i] will be a full update of the original game featuring all new artwork. and is a free upgrade for existing players! 

[previewyoutube=QM2GaTpuuPU;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

While it's predecessors are getting updates, our My Lovely Empress Demo will be available to play for one more week! So prepare yourselves for a taste of the latest installment in the My Lovely Series. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052990?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=juneDD&utm_medium=steam

We hope these promised offerings will be enough to summon your continued enthusiasm for the My Lovely Series, and we are looking forward to you all experiencing these updates on the 23rd of June! 

~ Neon Doctrine 💖

notes.title: Feast your eyes upon the UPDATED 3D Demo.
notes.content:
Greetings, 

The fated hour has arrived and Steam Next Fest is upon us. 

[h3]🚨 3D Demo Live Now! [/h3]
It's time for you to feast your eyes upon the UPDATED Demo of My Lovely Empress, featuring:
[list]
[*] All new 3D Animated Models
[*] New Yaoguai to unlock 
[*] New content to enjoy 
[*] Balancing updates, polishing, and bug fixes
[/list] Download and play the latest demo now to see the results of all the hard work of Neon Doctrine and GameChanger Studio!

[previewyoutube=u9RYZYxKkbo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎥 Livestream[/h3]
On [b]June 10th, 7pm PDT,[/b] see GameChanger Studio's own Lovely Empress; CEO Riris, playing My Lovely Empress and discussing her involvement in the development of the game. 

[h3]💀A Challenge, If You Dare...[/h3]
Our dearest Emperor, we would like to propose a mission for you -  We believe My Lovely Empress deserves only the highest of accolades from its inclusion in Next Fest and desire its appearance on the most played demos list. 

So join us in playing the Demo throughout the week, and show the world the power of the Crimson Emperor. 

[h3]✍🏻 Feedback Please! [/h3]
Please leave us your feedback on the demo at this form: https://forms.gle/Q3uKPEzteEMHqF6b7

We value any and all feedback we receive, and those of you who provide us with meaningful responses will be recognized through a credit in the game! 

Now, your 3D Yaoguai await your orders my lord. 

~ Neon Doctrine 👑

From May 9 - 16 only, experience a sneak peek at the might of the imperial throne. Manage the Crimson Empire and its competing factions, while using the citizenry as fuel for the darkest of magics. Summon the mysterious and deadly Yaoguai to do your bidding, and learn the secrets of their supernatural powers!
